headline: President Bush creates a commission focused on the United States Postal Service.
what_it_does: This executive order sets up a presidential commission on the United States Postal Service. Based on the title, the commission's job appears to be studying the Postal Service and advising the President. No summary was provided, so details about its members, specific tasks, and deadlines are not covered here.

who_it_affects.how: The Postal Service is the subject of the commission's review, though the order itself does not appear to change postal rules or services directly.
